source.section: nRF5340 features; Figure 2 Memory map; 3.2.1 RAM

notes: Compute-core policy (same principle as stm32h747xi.json and cxd5602.json): total_sram_bytes/total_flash_bytes report the application core's figures (512 KB RAM / 1 MB flash), since that is the core a TFLM build runs on in practice. The network core (64 KB RAM / 256 KB flash, not reported here) runs the Bluetooth/802.15.4 radio protocol stack, not general application code -- this project's compute-core policy explicitly excludes radio/IO/GNSS-oriented cores, and the network core is exactly that case. Unlike STM32H747's shared SRAM, this is a genuine architectural split, not a shared pool with one core barred from part of it: the datasheet draws two independent memory-map diagrams (Figure 2), one per core, each with its own Flash and RAM region at a different base address, and Section 3.2.1 states 'Each RAM AHB slave within a core is connected to one or more RAM sections' -- there is no single combined pool to sum or choose a subset of. docs.nordicsemi.com blocks automated fetches; content verified against an Octopart-hosted mirror of the identical document (820 pp., relevant sections read in full, including the app-core/network-core feature summary and the memory-map figure).
